items.definition:
a long, narrow boat used in Venice
We took a romantic ride in a gondola through the canals of Venice.

a photograph of a person's head or face
The actor needed a new headshot for his portfolio.

the state of being unable to help oneself
She felt a profound sense of helplessness when she couldn't find her way home.

a shy, reticent person
As an introvert, she prefers quiet evenings at home to large parties.

a skilled worker who has completed an apprenticeship but is not yet a master
After his apprenticeship, he worked as a journeyman carpenter for several years.

a machine for shaping wood or metal
He used a lathe to turn the wooden bowl.

a state of disorder due to a disregard of the law
The city descended into lawlessness after the earthquake.

a day on which a sports match is played
Fans gathered early for matchday excitement.

an international radio distress signal
The pilot sent a Mayday call after engine failure.

a soldier armed with a musket
The story is about a brave musketeer.

a person who plays the organ
The organist played a beautiful hymn during the service.

a small wild plant with pale yellow flowers
The garden was full of colorful primroses.

a golf club used for putting
He used his putter to tap the ball into the hole.

a native or inhabitant of Qatar
A Qatari delegation arrived for the summit.

mechanical or habitual repetition
Learning by rote can be effective for memorization, but not for understanding.

jazz singing with improvised nonsense syllables; animal droppings
The detective found bear scat near the campsite.

an act of selling all of something; a betrayal
The concert was a complete sellout.

a list of songs performed at a concert
The band played an amazing setlist at the festival.

mucus from the nose
He wiped the snot from his nose.

a pattern of criss-crossed horizontal and vertical bands in multiple colours
He wore a kilt made of traditional Scottish tartan.

main road or public path
The busy thoroughfare was lined with shops and restaurants.

software designed to protect against computer viruses
You should install antivirus software on your computer.

a member of a legislative assembly
The assemblyman proposed a new bill on environmental protection.

a highly skilled basketball player; a successful and wealthy person
He's a real baller on the court, always scoring points.

a strong covering holding the pages of a book together; a legal agreement
The old book had a beautiful leather binding.

the quality of being bold, daring, or courageous
Her boldness in challenging the decision was admirable.

the action or result of breaking something
The company is not responsible for any breakage during shipping.

a doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases
My grandfather sees a cardiologist for his heart condition.

an absurd pretense intended to create a pleasant or respectable appearance
Their happy marriage was just a charade to outsiders.

A warm, dry wind descending the eastern slopes of the Rocky Mountains, or a type of salmon.
The chinook wind brought unseasonably warm temperatures to the valley.

The state or fact of existing at the same time or in the same place.
Peaceful coexistence between different cultures is essential for global harmony.

A person from one's own country.
He met a compatriot while traveling abroad.

A shape or figure cut out from something, or a device that automatically disconnects an electrical circuit.
The store had a life-sized cardboard cutout of the movie star.

Enthusiasm to do or to have something; keenness.
Her eagerness to learn new things was admirable.

The point on the earth's surface vertically above the focus of an earthquake.
The earthquake's epicenter was located offshore.

physical or mental effort
The climb required great exertion.

a person who helps a group of people work together better
The facilitator guided the discussion smoothly.

fan fiction
She spends hours reading fanfic online.

a pole on which a flag is flown
The flagstaff stood tall in the town square.

a strip of gathered or pleated material used as an ornamental edging or trimming
The dress had a delicate frill around the collar.

an informal means of circulating information or gossip
I heard it through the grapevine that she's leaving.

a North American marmot, known for its supposed ability to predict the arrival of spring
On Groundhog Day, people watch to see if the groundhog sees its shadow.

a member of a small independent group taking part in irregular fighting, typically against larger regular forces
The guerilla fighters launched a surprise attack.

an intense but short-lived passion or admiration for someone or something
His infatuation with the new car quickly faded.

a slight knowledge or suspicion; a hint
I had an inkling that something was wrong.

a substance used for killing insects
Farmers often use insecticide to protect their crops.

a light spear thrown in a track-and-field event or used as a weapon
The athlete threw the javelin a record distance.

a small hill or mound
They picnicked on a grassy knoll overlooking the valley.

A woman who rents out rooms, a house, or land.
The landlady collected the rent on the first of the month.

A tendency or partiality.
She has a strong leaning towards classical music.

A long-tailed crow-like bird.
A magpie flew past the window, carrying a shiny object.

A mosque.
They went to the masjid for evening prayers.

The process in a woman of discharging blood and other material from the lining of the uterus at intervals of about one lunar month from puberty until the menopause, except during pregnancy.
Menstruation is a natural biological process.

A style or technique (as in music, literature, or design) that is characterized by extreme spareness and simplicity.
Her apartment was decorated in a style of minimalism.

A feeling of doubt or apprehension about the outcome or consequences of something.
He had serious misgivings about the plan.

A person or thing that provides a reason for doing something.
He was a great motivator for the team.

A material (such as decaying leaves, bark, or compost) spread around or over a plant to enrich or insulate the soil.
She spread mulch around the rose bushes.

A light gun with a long barrel, typically smooth-bored, muzzle-loading, and formerly used by infantry.
Soldiers in the 18th century often carried a musket.

a nonparticipant observer; a spectator
The onlookers gathered around the accident scene.

a material prepared in ancient Egypt from the pithy stem of a water plant, used as a writing surface
Ancient Egyptians wrote on sheets of papyrus.

a small colorless disk-shaped cell fragment without a nucleus, found in large numbers in blood and involved in clotting
Platelets are essential for blood clotting.

a member of a people inhabiting Polynesia; the group of Austronesian languages spoken in Polynesia
Many Polynesians are skilled navigators.

the quality of being able to be carried or moved easily
The laptop's portability makes it ideal for travel.

the quality or state of being random
The randomness of the lottery results makes it exciting.
